pages.text: A modular bow becomes a crossbow at the $(l)Crossbow Bench$(), which also fits it with one $(l)attachment$().$(br2)You get a single slot: a real choice, not a power-stack.
Craft a Crossbow Bench to build and modify crossbows.

pages.title: Attachments
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Scope$(): zoom and steadier aim$(li)$(l)Magazine$(): holds several bolts for burst fire, at the cost of a slower reload$(li)$(l)Bayonet$(): a blade for when they get close$(br2)Attachments swap freely at the bench.

pages.title: Tuning & Woods
pages.text: A crossbow keeps the $(l)Tuning %$() of the bow it was made from, and here it buys a $(l)faster reload$() rather than a faster draw. Build the bow well and the crossbow inherits it.$(br2)It keeps the bow's woods too, so a $(l:equipment/composite_bows)Composite Bow$() becomes a composite crossbow.
